pedals.axis.rudder.name: Rudder
pedals.axis.rudder.note: rocker arm over the main shaft; rudder axis has no axis letter in the manual (no input)

pedals.axis.brake_left.name: Left toe brake
pedals.axis.brake_left.note: left pedal plate (upper left), manual Ry

pedals.axis.brake_right.name: Right toe brake
pedals.axis.brake_right.note: right pedal plate (lower right), manual Rx

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), pedals seen from the pilot's seat side, front-left and above: left pedal at the upper left, right pedal at the lower right, rocker arm with HALL sensor and centering spring in the middle
mappingSource: WinCtrl "Orion 32 Rudder Pedals Metal 1.0 (O.R.32.MET.1) User Manual V1.0 2025.09.04" section 3.2 Buttons drawing, page 8 (https://eu.winctrl.com/static/ipfs/QmTY8EjMA7JwXrPhnkf6ksToihf49mrjEPx6Uz45DBeh2X): left toe brake = Ry, right toe brake = Rx (0-65535); the rudder (main shaft, 0-65535) is drawn without an axis letter, so it has no input in the catalog
note: Toe brakes are the pedal plates tilting on their lower hinges; markers sit on the upper (toe) half of each plate. The rudder marker sits on the rocker arm above the main shaft.
